item.title: 🔴 Rust Supply Chain Attack Puts Build-Time Malware in Crates with 245 Million Downloads
item.description:
Why this matters: Supply-chain risk — review third-party access and affected vendor dependencies.
The Rust Project has deleted malicious versions of three widely used Rust crates from crates.io after a compromised maintainer account published releases that added a typosquatted dependency whose build script downloaded and executed a remote payload during compilation. The affected releases are arrayref 0.3.10, internment 0.8.7, and append-only-vec 0.1.9, all published from the same owner

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 13h

item.title: 🔴 Ransom Busters Claims It Hacked Ransomware Servers, Asks Victims for Up to $60,000
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups, endpoint protection, and recovery readiness.
